features.title: Google PageSpeed Optimization
features.description: Core Web Vitals optimizations for CrazyGames, Kizi, Poki and Y8.

features.title: Crazy Visual Presets T
features.description: 18 CrazyGames color palettes plus a browser-only CrazyGames, Poki, Kizi or Y8 theme preview.

features.title: Translate
features.description: A visitor language selector with popular languages first and browser-only preferences.

features.title: Menu Design
features.description: Responsive discovery menus and matching Home layouts for every public template.
features.release_notes:
v1.6.6: Neutralize legacy Search positioning so the Y8 field stays usable in the desktop header.
v1.6.5: Keep Y8 Search inside the top header row on every desktop page.
v1.6.4: Reliable Y8 played-game tracking with the most recently played game first on Home and Played Games.
v1.6.3: Fast native Y8 search suggestions with compact images and a reliable full-results fallback.
v1.6.2: Remove the obsolete Y8 category/tag menu from every public page.
v1.6.1: Larger semantic Y8 footer icons for Categories, Blog, YouTube, Contact, Theme and Translate.

features.title: CrazyGames Professional Theme
features.description: Premium CrazyGames dashboard with shared navigation, hover previews, player challenges, achievements, weekly leaderboard, mobile promotion and community widgets.
features.release_notes:
v1.1.0: Complete reference dashboard, functional progress panels and one shared top, left and footer navigation across every CrazyGames page.
v1.0.2: Complete compact history rails, six ordered category showcases and an always-present Play on Mobile panel.
v1.0.1: Full independent PRO shell matching the approved CrazyGames reference, with compact navigation, header, rails and persistent right dashboard.

features.title: Poki & Kizi Professional Themes
features.description: Independent Poki PRO mosaic and Kizi PRO arcade-board themes while preserving both classic templates.
features.release_notes: v1.0.0: Adds separate Poki PRO and Kizi PRO templates, responsive shared navigation on every page, local optimized images and interaction-aware loading.

features.title: Language
features.description: Complete stored-language manager for every PRO template, with API-gated configuration, XLSX import/export, validation, history and cron.
features.release_notes: v1.0.0: Dedicated PRO dashboard card and direct access to the installed language manager.

features.title: Other Fixes
features.description: Small public-site corrections delivered separately from major PRO features.
features.release_notes:
v1.3.3: Roll back the Y8 listing-card resize and restore the previous Y8 layout.
v1.3.1: Poki mosaic artwork fills every game card without empty lower strips.
v1.3.0: Optional Google tag ID in Admin Settings; empty settings emit no Google script or request.
v1.2.0: NEW badges appear only during the first 24 hours after a game is published.
v1.1.0: Favorite Games page, persistent heart toggle, menu link, and responsive game sliders.
v1.0.0: Category and tag pages show one short sentence above the games without duplicate text or Show more.
